text: Code reviews are an important practice in software development. When developers review each other's code, they can catch bugs early, before the code goes into production. This saves time and money because fixing problems later is much harder. Code reviews also help with knowledge sharing. Team members learn from each other and understand different parts of the project. This makes the whole team stronger. In addition, regular code reviews improve team quality. Everyone follows the same standards, and the final product is more reliable. For these reasons, code reviews should be a normal part of every development team's work.
